tickets.goal: Review docs/CODEX_START.md against the repository as it exists now. Update only stale factual branch, PR, completed-gate, or development-entrypoint references. Preserve the project rules and do not invent status. Modify only docs/CODEX_START.md.

Review NEXT_STEPS.md against the current repository and merged implementation. Remove or rewrite only clearly stale completed next steps and make the remaining immediate technical priorities concrete. Do not broaden scope. Modify only NEXT_STEPS.md.
